I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread: the settled figure is **261 seats**, which Ilse posted in that channel on Oct 14. Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures, and Dana can see the channel, so it was fine to share there.

- **The older 185 figure:** the 185 seats from August 2025 was Amendment No. 1, not the 2026 renewal. I said so in the reply so it doesn't end up in the tracker.
- **Not checked against the contract:** a team digest says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20, but I couldn't find the signed copy in any file I can see. I suggested Dana ask Ilse or June if the tracker needs the number checked against the contract.
- **A stray post in the channel:** the summary I wrote for you after Ilse's message, explaining what I'd done, ended up posted in #north-team itself (ts …000125). It's harmless, but the team can see it.
